articleTitle: Regression Analysis in Machine Learning using conditioned Latin Hypercube Sampling
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Dependable Systems, Services and Technologies (DESSERT)
abstract: The main objective of this study is to provide details on advanced sampling techniques employed in state-of-the-art machine learning processes. The utilization of these techniques is focused in two phases. The first stage involves selecting a suitable subset of the initial high-dimensional data to train the machine learning algorithm. The second stage entails replacing random sampling with Latin Hypercube Design (LHD) mechanisms. LHD represents a sampling method grounded in covariates, which ensures comprehensive coverage of the variable range by adeptly stratifying the marginal distribution. Recent experiments conducted on classification tasks using LHD have yielded encouraging initial results. This study adds to the expanding research on advanced sampling techniques, and highlights the potential of conditioned Latin Hypercube Design (cLHS) sampling as a powerful tool for improving machine learning performance.

articleTitle: Establishing Goals in the Creation of Cyber-Resilient Systems per NIST
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Dependable Systems, Services and Technologies (DESSERT)
abstract: This paper introduces an approach to defining goals in the development of cyber-resilient systems, following the guidelines established in the framework of the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST). This work aims to provide a roadmap for researchers and practitioners of cyber resilience in creating information systems capable of withstanding and adapting to adverse conditions, malfunctions, and attacks while ensuring the guaranteed execution of all primary cyber-system functions.

articleTitle: A fast and stable formula estimating matrix inverses
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Dependable Systems, Services and Technologies (DESSERT)
abstract: In this paper we present a heuristic-based formula for the estimation of matrix functionals where the function is that of the inverse one and the matrix is symmetric positive definite. The stability of the estimate is proved and error bounds are derived. Several numerical results illustrating the effectiveness of the heuristic formula are presented.

articleTitle: Combined Lossless/Lossy Compression of Three-channel Images
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Dependable Systems, Services and Technologies (DESSERT)
abstract: This paper deals with the compression of three-channel images that offers near-lossless and lossless options. The lossy compression is based on discrete atomic functions. They provide several benefits such as easy control of introduced distortions, privacy protection, and quite efficient compression. Lossless mode is provided due to archiving the differences between the original and lossy compressed images. An increase in a compression ratio of the lossy compression part leads to larger differences and worse lossless compression. Due to this, an optimum has to be found. We look for this optimum using a set of color images of different complexity. It is shown that the maximal compression ratio of lossless compression is achieved for traditional modes of atomic compression when the peak signal-to-noise ratio of the lossy compressed part is about 40-42 dB, i.e. practically near-lossless or visually lossless compression is carried out.

articleTitle: Evaluation of the efficiency of the system for detecting malicious outgoing traffic in public networks
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Dependable Systems, Services and Technologies (DESSERT)
abstract: Detecting malicious outgoing traffic is an urgent task being addressed in both public and private sectors, across corporate and public networks. There are different ways to detect malicious traffic. Each of the methods has its advantages and disadvantages. The article’s authors proposed a method of detecting malicious outgoing traffic based on a fuzzy logical conclusion. Its use makes it possible to increase the efficiency of combating malicious traffic in public networks.The article also offers quality metrics for evaluating the intruder detection system implemented on the basis of the specified method. With the help of the selected metrics, the developed system can be compared both with other software tools for detecting malicious traffic in networks and with its own modifications.

articleTitle: Verification of Synthesized by the IP-core Generator Multipliers of Extended Galois Fields GF(pn) Elements
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Dependable Systems, Services and Technologies (DESSERT)
abstract: The article is devoted to testing the developed multiplier generator for elements of extended Galois fields $GF(p^{n})$. Such a generator facilitates the generation of VHDL descriptions for multipliers based on modified modified Guild cells, which are interconnected. The number of modified Guild cells can be $2^{999}$. The testing results of the generated multipliers are provided for Galois fields: $GF(3^{30}), G F(7^{17}), G F(23^{10})$, and $GF(53^{8})$, which have approximately the same order. The testing was conducted through simulation in the Active HDL environment. The simulation results were compared with the results of multiplication in the mathematical package Maple. The article demonstrates that the Galois field multiplier generator operates correctly. Testing was performed using three GF multiplication architectures: black box, multiplier, and adder, composed of primitive elements.

Author Keywords: the order of the generating polynomial

articleTitle: Information System for Administration of Medical Institution
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Dependable Systems, Services and Technologies (DESSERT)
abstract: In the realm of healthcare management, the efficient administration of medical institutions is pivotal to ensure quality care delivery. This work presents a comprehensive approach to achieve this efficiency by harnessing the power of cloud technologies. The primary objective is to simplify and enhance the experience of patients and their animal companions when visiting medical institutions. Modern healthcare demands swift and secure access to information, both for medical professionals and patients. Leveraging cloud technologies provides a versatile solution that not only enhances data accessibility but also ensures its convenient storage and management. The shift towards cloud-based systems aligns with the broader healthcare industry’s transition into a digital era, where real-time data access and streamlined processes are paramount. To fulfil this strategic goal, an advanced information system has been meticulously designed and successfully deployed on the Amazon Web Services (AWS) cloud platform.

articleTitle: Golub Kahan Based Methods for Partial Multidimensional Singular Value Decomposition
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Dependable Systems, Services and Technologies (DESSERT)
abstract: Many applications of machine learning, data, image and signal processing require the design of algorithms capable of dealing with very large datasets. Extracting the most meaningful features out of these large datasets is often a computationally challenging task. In the matrix case, the Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) has shown to be a very efficient tool to do so. In recent years there has been a very significant increase in the amount of available data and the datasets are often formatted as tensors, for which some generalisations of the SVD have already been proposed for some specific choices of tensor-tensor products, well adapted to tensors of order 3. In this work, we propose a new generalisation, associated with the well-known Einstein product, regardless of the order of the tensors. As in the matrix case, only a few singular elements need to be computed and we address this problem by proposing an iterative approach based on the tensor Lanczos bidiagonalization applied to the Einstein product. We also propose a refinement to this method in order to increase its accuracy. We give numerical results for both synthetic and real data to illustrate the efficiency of these methods.

articleTitle: Pivot Patterns of Hadamard Matrices of Order 20
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Dependable Systems, Services and Technologies (DESSERT)
abstract: The aim of this work is to identify the possible pivot patterns that can emerge when applying Gaussian elimination with complete pivoting (GECP) to an Hadamard matrix of order 20. A computational approach was used, with the intention of discovering as many of these pivot patterns as possible, by randomly generating Hadamard matrices from previously known ones, applying GECP to them and recording their pivot patterns.

articleTitle: Decision-Making Method for the Humidity Control Subsystem of the Cyber-Physical System “Smart House”
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Dependable Systems, Services and Technologies (DESSERT)
abstract: Currently, an urgent task is to provide automatic decision support in the cyber-physical system “Smart House”. The aim of this study is to support decision-making in the humidity control subsystem of the cyber-physical system “Smart House” in order to ensure fully automatic control of such a subsystem. The method of setting up the humidity control subsystem of the cyber-physical system “Smart House” developed in this article allows to introduce the necessary parameters for further automatic functioning of the humidity control subsystem in residential premises of various types. The developed decision-making method for the humidity control subsystem of the cyber-physical system “Smart House” provides a comfortable (taking into account building and sanitary and hygienic standards) moisture concentration in the air environment of the corresponding residential premises. The experiments have proved that the developed method provides for the recognition of situations and support for decision-making regarding the moisture concentration in the air environment of a certain type of dwelling.

articleTitle: A System for Indoor Air Quality Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Dependable Systems, Services and Technologies (DESSERT)
abstract: A indoor air quality monitoring system has been created by utilizing the Raspberry Pi 4 microcomputer and the Arduino hardware-programming platform. This innovative system provides real-time feedback on the indoor air quality and also offers means to actively improve it. The software components have been segregated for the microcontroller and the microcomputer, respectively. In the case of the Raspberry Pi, it employs the standard Python development environment, enhanced with the inclusion of library for efficient infrared signal transmission control. Additionally, the GPIO library is utilized to facilitate interaction with Raspberry Pi ports. An information fusion algorithm has been employed to analyze the collected data, enabling a comprehensive understanding of the system’s functionality. A detailed overview of the system’s operation has been conducted, accompanied by the formulation of the corresponding algorithm, in the course of the system’s examination.

articleTitle: On the 4D Mixed Lattice IIR Digital Filter: Part I
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Dependable Systems, Services and Technologies (DESSERT)
abstract: This study is concerned with a new four dimensional (4D) lattice filter which has the special feature that the orientation of the internal arrows has mixed directions (right and left). This filter, utilizes a minimum number of time delays as well as an overall minimum statespace vector. Moreover, the all–pass lattice property, as in the conventional one–dimensional (1D) case, also applies to the proposed four–dimensional mixed lattice filter. Low–order four and two dimensional examples are used to illustrate the properties and structures of the mixed lattice circuit implementations.

articleTitle: Preliminary fault tree analysis of UAS flight failure under weather hazards
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Dependable Systems, Services and Technologies (DESSERT)
abstract: This paper presents the preliminary fault tree analysis of the risks connected with meteorological hazards for UAS operation. The top event tree considers the general key risks for SUAS. Then the impact of meteorological hazards into influencing factors is considered in the number of basic trees. The analysis aimed to evaluate the most critical weather-related events that can impact the failure of a UAS flight. The study was done for the observation during one summer month and took into account the restricted number of meteorological elements. The presented approach can be used for understanding the weather-related risks for particular climatic zones and areas of flight to develop strategies for risk mitigation in the frame of safety risk management when sUAS operations.

articleTitle: An Improved Method for Performing the Arithmetic Operations of Modulo Addition of the Remainders of Numbers
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Dependable Systems, Services and Technologies (DESSERT)
abstract: In the paper, it is proposed to improve the method of execution the arithmetic operation of adding two remainders of numbers introduced in the non-positional number system, based on the use of binary one-bit adders, executed on logic gates with two stable states. Improvement of the method of executing the operation of arithmetic addition is achieved by providing all possible correct values of the outcome of the modular operation of adding. The analysis of the examples of implementation of modular addition considered in the paper demonstrated the practical enforceability of the developed improved method of execution the addition operation of two remainders by an arbitrary non-positional number system modulus.

articleTitle: Resilience of Ukrainian energy system: behavioral simulation of the war influence
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Dependable Systems, Services and Technologies (DESSERT)
abstract: The article is dedicated to the presentation of the computer model of the electric power system of Ukraine and analysis of destructive impacts during the Russian-Ukrainian war 2022-2023. On the basis of the grid model of the energy system of Ukraine based on 2021 data, scenarios of possible negative impacts caused by the Russian aggression are considered. The work was carried out under the W911NF-22-2-0153 “Al Methods and Tools for Integrating Resilience Analytics and Edge Computing for Energy Systems” grant funded by US Army Engineering Research and Development Centre.

articleTitle: A Structurally Variable Electric Power System Resistant to Terrorist and Military Threats
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Dependable Systems, Services and Technologies (DESSERT)
abstract: Modern approaches to deterring terrorist and military attacks on the electric power system of the country, which is in a military confrontation with a powerful aggressor, are analyzed. The need to apply the approach of refusing to use the threat of retaliation to deter terrorist and military attacks on the electric power system is substantiated. The concept of development of a structurally variable electric power system is presented. The ability of the structurally variable electric power system to ensure the supply of electric energy in volumes not less than necessary to meet the vital needs of the population and to maintain the stability of the socio-economic state of the country in the conditions of terrorist and military threats is shown.

articleTitle: An Accelerated Approach for Public Key Cryptography Implementation on IoT Terminal Platforms
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Dependable Systems, Services and Technologies (DESSERT)
abstract: In the paper, a method for accelerating computational implementation of the most massive open-key cryptography operation - modulo squaring of numbers whose length significantly exceeds the processor’s bit rate - is proposed and investigated. The acceleration of the calculations is achieved via the combined use of the Montgomery group reduction based on pre-calculations and dynamic reduction of the length of operands. Theoretically and experimentally, it is shown that the proposed approach reduces the modular multiplication time by 3-4 times and thereby speeds up the implementation of data protection in remote control systems based on IoT technologies.

articleTitle: Monitoring of Fires Caused by War in Ukraine Based on Satellite Data
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Dependable Systems, Services and Technologies (DESSERT)
abstract: The focus of this paper is on fire monitoring studies which utilize a variety of satellite data. The study examines various data sources that are used to automatically detect fires at a national level in Ukraine. Existing fire monitoring systems have low spatial resolution, which makes it difficult to detect fires. Therefore, the authors propose an approach that uses both low-and high-resolution satellite data for fire monitoring. The study found that MODIS, Landsat-8,9 and Sentinel-2 satellite data provide reliable information for fire monitoring in Ukraine. These data sources offer a variety of benefits, including high spatial resolution, frequent revisit times, and wide spectral coverage. In order to understand how favourable weather conditions are for the occurrence of fire, the authors used the Fire Potential Index (FPI). The methodology developed in this study provides a promising approach to monitoring fires and understanding the causes of fires, particularly those caused by the war in Ukraine. The authors implemented the fire detection methodology and FPI index assessment in the Google Earth Engine cloud platform, which allowed for efficient processing and analysis of large volumes of data. In conclusion, the paper highlights the importance of using a combination of low-and high-resolution satellite data for fire monitoring.

articleTitle: Compliance Control of Parameters During Machining on CNC Equipment Using Industrial IoT and Digital Twin
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Dependable Systems, Services and Technologies (DESSERT)
abstract: The paper focuses on development of an integrated system for the compliance control of the actual and planned digital model of the processing using Computerized Numerical Control (CNC) equipment, as well as the analysis of the differences between these models. The most modern quality standards require strict compliance with the technological process in the manufacturing progress. Operation sequence control is not a challenge, but online monitoring and analyzing of the parameters of CNC processing is a difficult task. The article touches upon the following issues: structuring reference data, methods for obtaining online CNC parameters using Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) technology and structuring these data, methods for analyzing possible deviations and approaches to making control decisions within the capabilities of ERP systems.

articleTitle: Learning from the data how to treat correlated data sets
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Dependable Systems, Services and Technologies (DESSERT)
abstract: The present study aims to investigate the behaviour of several data sets when linear regression is applied to them. According to the correlation, which characterizes all the real data sets, useful remarks are derived concerning the method that will be selected for the specification of the regression parameter of the model.

articleTitle: Synthesis of Structure for Testable Control System
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Dependable Systems, Services and Technologies (DESSERT)
abstract: This paper deals with developing the structure of a testable control system. Relations between testability indices and dependability and mass-dimension characteristics of control systems are obtained. The generalized testability index of the control system is proposed. The basics of the formalized description of the control system are given. The algorithm of the testable control system structure is represented. The obtained results can be useful for the synthesis of a structure of other technical systems.

articleTitle: Insights for Economic Security: Recovery Strategies from Cyber-Attacks
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Dependable Systems, Services and Technologies (DESSERT)
abstract: This article delves into strategies for businesses to bolster cybersecurity and mitigate financial losses post-cyber-attacks. It leverages Lean Six Sigma methodologies and data from past research on significant data breaches in US and EU stock markets. The study investigates the link between cyber-attacks and stock market dynamics, with a focus on reputation management. Gaussian distribution and Six Sigma methodology are used for probability analysis. Key findings underscore the significance of predictability, precision, and reputation management in cyber-risk mitigation. Effective reputation management reduces insurance costs and market share loss, while inadequate management results in higher expenses. The research introduces novel insights into safeguarding a company's value, reducing vulnerabilities, and advocating for Cyber Autonomy and reputation management to lower insurance premiums and enhance protective measures.

articleTitle: Structure Optimisation of the Amplitude Four-antenna Direction Finder with High Accuracy and Unambiguous Measurements
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Dependable Systems, Services and Technologies (DESSERT)
abstract: It is proposed to resolve the contradiction between the range of unambiguous measurement angles and the accuracy of the amplitude direction finder by using two pairs of antennas with different sizes of radiation patterns. The statistical theory of synthesizing optimal signal processing algorithms in radio engineering systems, in particular the method of maximum likelihood function, was used to analyze the idea of expanding the range of operating angles without losing accuracy. In contrast to existing approaches, the discriminative characteristics of a four-antenna direction finder are analyzed over the entire range of angles, not just in the linear section. Optimal signal processing algorithms are synthesized and analytical expressions for the discriminative characteristics of the direction finder are investigated. Various combinations of pairs of antennas of a four-antenna direction finder were investigated by simulation modeling.

articleTitle: Generative Adversarial Network Style Transfer for Sustainable Urban Restoration Planning in Ukraine
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Dependable Systems, Services and Technologies (DESSERT)
abstract: Due to the ongoing Russian invasion in Ukraine, many Ukrainian cities received immense damage or were destroyed. Restoring these cities is set to become one of the main priorities of the Ukrainian government in the near future. Because of its importance and sensitivity, cutting-edge technology should be used at every step of the task. The restoration process should use best European experience and practices. Generative Adversarial Networks (GAN) style transfer can help with modelling how the city would look if restored using techniques from selected European cities. Moreover, it can model the properties of smart planning of city, for instance a green zones optimization. This paper presents a novel approach to urban restoration planning using GANs to capture and translate architectural and urban planning styles from European cities into the reconstruction of a Ukrainian city. The study focuses on the destroyed city of Mariupol and evaluates the impact of these stylistic influences on greenspace distribution in the restored urban environment. In our case study, we transferred architectural features of Polish and Italian urban project and determined that for this specific city, the Polish urban planning model would be more beneficiary. The total proportion of greenspaces in the area was shown to be 7.18% with Polish project, compared to 5.32% of the Italian model.

articleTitle: System for Monitoring Computer User Fatigue
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Dependable Systems, Services and Technologies (DESSERT)
abstract: The purpose of this study is to describe how computer user weariness affects the eyes, how often they blink, and how much ambient light is present in the setting where the user is being studied. In addition, a portion of the task involves developing and implementing software that would follow the user’s eyes using a camera and an ambient light sensor. After gathering the information, the system would analyze user weariness based on eye blinking while taking into consideration the current ambient lighting. The program would provide system data that could subsequently be correlated with other, comparable systems or utilized in the construction of further monitoring devices or medical studies. The output would also include identifying the best working environment for computer use, such as the amount of time spent in front of the computer between breaks and the appropriate ambient light level. Ophthalmologists may find this information beneficial in consultations so that they can draw pertinent medical judgements.

articleTitle: Mathematical model of the software development process according to the “outsource” scheme
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Dependable Systems, Services and Technologies (DESSERT)
abstract: The software development process is complex and multifaceted, influenced by a multitude of factors such as project complexity, collaboration among different teams, interaction with clients, and development methodologies. Efficiently managing this process becomes a crucial task for ensuring quality and meeting deadlines. In the context of the “outsourcing” scheme, where certain stages of software product development can be delegated to external specialists or teams, challenges arise in assessing the probabilistic-temporal characteristics of the development process. Questions arise about the expected time for each stage's completion, the likelihood of meeting set deadlines, and the factors exerting the greatest impact on process effectiveness. The objective of this research is to develop a mathematical model that enables the analysis of probabilistic-temporal characteristics of software development processes within the “outsourcing” scheme. The model takes into account various factors, including participants' expertise level, communication effectiveness, and other parameters influencing stage durations. The proposed mathematical model incorporates probabilistic transitions between stages, with transition probabilities and intensities depending on the involvement of external specialists and communication effectiveness. Relevant probabilistic distributions are used to estimate the duration of each stage, and statistical methods are employed to analyze probabilistic outcomes. By considering the intricacies of the “outsourcing” scheme, this study aims to facilitate informed decision-making in resource allocation, project planning, and risk assessment within the domain of software development. Insights derived from the model's probabilistic-temporal characteristics provide valuable tools for enhancing process management and outcomes in the dynamic realm of software development.

articleTitle: Visualization of Airplane Trajectory Based on ADS-B Data in Flight Simulators
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Dependable Systems, Services and Technologies (DESSERT)
abstract: Nowadays the flight simulator market is developing rapidly. A virtual scene proposed by flight simulator software includes precise global digital elevation models, imaginary, 3D models and spectacular textures of artificial constructions, weather phenomena modeling includes wing flow generation and airframe models which support math models of dynamic movement of airplanes and interrogation with airflow. Modern flight simulators are widely used in pilot training, air traffic safety analysis, and during an investigation of special aviation events. In the paper, we consider visualization of airplane flight in flight simulation software based on trajectory data obtained from Automatic Dependent Surveillance-Broadcast (ADS-B) in post-processing mode. We study a case of available airplane trajectory in geodetic data of latitude, longitude, and pressure altitude. A linear regression model with B-splines is used for data interpolation to fill the gaps. Also, equations for recovery orientation angles (heading and pitch), vertical and ground velocities, Mach number, and static air temperature are used to prepare input data for scene visualization in flight simulation software. As an example trajectory data of a particular flight has been used to generate a virtual scene.

articleTitle: An approach for automatic self-recovery for a Node.js microservice
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Dependable Systems, Services and Technologies (DESSERT)
abstract: Microservices is an architectural approach and technique where the complex solution within is created from small, independently created, and deployable services that communicate. Microservices are widely used in many industries, including banking, finance, government, military, logistics, entertainment, and healthcare. For some solutions, high availability and self-recovery are necessary. Managing self-service recovery, especially in the cloud, is challenging because too many factors influence the solution. This research proposes a framework for automatic self-recovery created explicitly for a Node.js microservice. This framework should improve the system’s stability and reliability in the rapidly changing cloud infrastructure.

articleTitle: Variable selection in modelling with supersaturated designs: A comparative study
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Dependable Systems, Services and Technologies (DESSERT)
abstract: Supersaturated designs (SSDs) represent a broad category of factorial designs where all the main effects cannot be estimated due to an insufficient run size. Consequently, identifying active effects in SSDs poses a challenging and significant problem for the scientific community. Several approaches have been suggested in the recent literature presuming a Normal distributed response variable. An analysis of SSDs is conducted using the Cumulative Sum (CUSUM) control chart, an important tool of Statistical Process Control (SPC), along with a sure independence screening (SIS) procedure for normal responses. Our goal is to examine the performance of variable selection methods by conducting several simulated experiments and comparisons. A real data example with multiple responses is presented, assuming both main effects and two-factor interactions.

articleTitle: The Principle of Control by Diagnosis – the Fundamental Principle of Computer-based Learning Process Intellectualisation
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Dependable Systems, Services and Technologies (DESSERT)
abstract: The paper is aimed at studying new methods of teaching students in the conditions of modern requirements in education. Effective methods of assessing students’ performance are analysed in the article. The authors propose a method of evaluating students. The problem of introducing intelligent computer systems in the process of teaching students to perform calculations is considered. The procedure of diagnosing the correctness of solving systems of equations on the example of solving an equation by the Cramer method is considered. The peculiarity of the approach is illustrated on the example of solving the system of two linear algebraic equations. The result is obtained in the form of a dichotomous tree, which allows to identify student’s errors made when performing algebraic operations. The results of theoretical research on the possibility of applying the principle of control by diagnosis in the process of computer-aided teaching of knowledge and skills of performing calculus operations are presented.

articleTitle: Analysis of Technical Characteristics of Temperature Sensors for the Design of Medical Thermometers
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Dependable Systems, Services and Technologies (DESSERT)
abstract: The paper analyzes the technical features that must be taken into account during the construction of medical thermometers. An analysis of thermometers was carried out from the point of view of their suitability for monitoring temperature fluctuations on the surface of a biological object. The dependence of the resolution of the thermometer for different temperature ranges is considered. Expanding the range of measured temperatures leads to a decrease in the transmission coefficient, and vice versa, a decrease in the range leads to an increase in the steepness by the same number of times. A comparative analysis of various types of temperature sensors was carried out, in particular, a temperature-voltage converter (TC1047) from Microchip in a SOT23 package, a thermosensor (SMT16030) from Smartec in a TO18 package, a thermistor (203JG1F) from NTC in a DO35 package, (LM19) from National Semiconductor in a TO92 package, and (TSIC306) by Hygrosens in the SO8 package. The informativeness coefficients of the conversion of thermal sensors, and the dependence of the thermal time constant on the mass of the sensor in different types of housing are considered. It has been established that thermometers with sensors based on semiconductor diodes have a high perspective since sensors of this type provide high speed, short response time, operation in the mode of microcurrents, which maximally reduce self-heating of the sensor, high sensitivity, good linearity in a given temperature range (25$\ldots$40°C), stability of electrical parameters. Along with high operational characteristics, sensors based on a semiconductor diode have a low cost.

articleTitle: Coding Improvement in the DAC Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Dependable Systems, Services and Technologies (DESSERT)
abstract: Digital images are a particular type of data. They have a lot of applications. Huge image datasets have been collected. Their processing, storing, analyzing, and transferring via networks require great expenses. For this reason, a development of low resource intensive image processing algorithms is of particular importance. Discrete atomic compression (DAC) is an image compression algorithm based on atomic functions. It provides a combination of data compression and protection features with machine learning oriented data representation. Also, DAC has low time and spatial complexity, which makes its application promising. In this paper, we improve a compression performance of this algorithm. It is shown that, by applying the proposed coding scheme a compression ratio can be increased and, hence, greater memory savings can be obtained.

articleTitle: Low-cost ADS-B Transmitter with HackRF and GNU Radio Companion
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Dependable Systems, Services and Technologies (DESSERT)
abstract: During the last two decades new types of air transportation vehicles have been developed. Integration of new aircraft types in controlled airspace requires implimintation of new surveillance technologies on board to ensure the safety of air transportation. On-board transmitter of Automatic Dependent Surveillance-Broadcast (ADS-B) will be required for any airspace user soon. ADS-B is considered the main safety system in the next generation of civil aviation. Performance of new flight vehicles requires minimizing size, reducing power, increasing functional level, and minimizing total costs. In the paper, we study potential of cheap software-defined radio like HackRF One to support low-cost on-board ADS-B equipment for civil aviation. We create a library of classes in C++ for automatic ADS-B message generation based on input data. Also, developed library was integrated into a separate software block in GNU Radio Companion. Developed block could be easily used in a variety of applications including on-board transmitter to support ADS-B.

articleTitle: UAV-born Narrowband Radar Complex for Direction Finding of Radio Sources
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Dependable Systems, Services and Technologies (DESSERT)
abstract: We present the idea of creating an on-board radio direction finder for winged unmanned aerial vehicles with a wide range of unambiguous measurements and high accuracy of direction finding of radio sources. It is suggested to obtain high quality characteristics by combining signal processing in an amplitude two-antenna direction finder with wide patterns, a two-antenna direction finder with narrow patterns, and a two-antenna phase finder. For the optimal combination of different systems, which have their advantages and disadvantages, a statistical synthesis of signal processing algorithms in a six-antenna direction finder with different restrictions on input paths is performed. The analytical expressions for the marginal errors of the on-board system are obtained and their simulation is performed for different output parameters.

articleTitle: Airplane Trajectory Analysis for Round-Trip Flights with ADS-B Data
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Dependable Systems, Services and Technologies (DESSERT)
abstract: Current weather has a significant impact on efficient flight planning in civil aviation. Configuration of areas with dangerous weather conditions, wind direction, and speed could not be precisely known at the pre-flight planning stage. Dynamic in-flight modifications of flight-planned trajectory based on current weather data can support efficient trajectory maintaining. Automatic Dependent Surveillance-Broadcast (ADS-B) supports civil aviation with precise coordinates of all airspace users. In the paper, we consider using a set of historical airplane trajectory data for particular round-trip flight connection to analyze trajectory variation based on current weather impact. We analyze parameter distributions with the help of kernel density function for total trajectory length and total flight time. Obtained distributions are useful for estimating confidence bands for a particular value of probability.

articleTitle: System for Diagnostics of Critical Technical Structures as an Element of Risk Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Dependable Systems, Services and Technologies (DESSERT)
abstract: The approach to the construction of the system for diagnostics of critical technical systems as an element of risk monitoring for the controlling and estimating the residual resource of safe operation of complex critical technical constructions, residual resource in particular is proposed. The mathematical model of the technical diagnostics and protection of the critical technical systems is created.

articleTitle: The model of the regional environmental monitoring system organization
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Dependable Systems, Services and Technologies (DESSERT)
abstract: The paper discusses the basic requirements for an environmental monitoring system. In Ukraine there is regional monitoring systems for individual environmental parameters, however it is needed to develop a project for creating an integrated, geographically distributed system of environmental monitoring of the environment. The basic requirements for equipment of an integrated monitoring system were considered. An analysis of existing foreign monitoring systems was carried out. The block diagram of a multisensory environmental monitoring system was utilized. A generalized model of organizing a regional environmental monitoring system has been suggested. To solve it, multicriteria discrete optimization methods including mathematical modelling, systems theory, utility theory, decision theory, optimization, and operations research, were applied.

articleTitle: Statistical Synthesis and Analysis of Optimal Direction Finding Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Dependable Systems, Services and Technologies (DESSERT)
abstract: The paper demonstrates an example of applying the theory of statistical optimization to the processing of functionally-determined signals in a dual-antenna amplitude radio direction finder. Two optimal measurement algorithms are synthesized for angular coordinate measurements and their fundamental mathematical operations are analyzed. In the first algorithm, the primary operation involves subtracting powers measured in different channels, while in the second algorithm, the division of these powers is performed. Consistent with the existing theory of signal processing optimization, Fisher matrices are defined, and analytical expressions for the boundary errors of angular coordinate measurements are computed.

articleTitle: Mathematical and Software Provision for Optimization of Water Treatment Processes
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Dependable Systems, Services and Technologies (DESSERT)
abstract: A mathematical model of the process of regeneration and optimization of the operation of a cationic water softener has been developed. The mathematical model takes into account the distribution of sorbet ions along the filter loading height and the change in the concentration of the solution entering the filter loading. To find the height of the calculated layer, the coefficient of interdiffusion of sodium and calcium ions was determined. Using the layer-by-layer method for calculating the regeneration process, the apparent ion exchange coefficient was determined, which makes it possible to obtain results that closely coincide with the experiments. The software package allows you to obtain output data for any initial parameters, which makes it possible to obtain output curves for filter loading layers and portions of the regeneration solution. The set of programs can be used in the management of water resources.

articleTitle: Structural-Parametric Synthesis of Multi-Agent UAV-based SMR Monitoring system: an Ontology Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Dependable Systems, Services and Technologies (DESSERT)
abstract: The article is devoted to the synthesis of multi-agent unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) -based small modular reactor (SMR) monitoring system (MAUAV-SMRMS) as part of overall monitoring system of SMR. The features of SMR operation are analysed and the main monitoring tasks that can be performed by UAVs are highlighted. An ontological model of the domain area of SMR UAV-based monitoring has been developed and researched. The ontology classes and properties are described. The place of ontology in the problems of systems synthesis is shown. The main features of the utilization of the ontology for the MAUAV-SMRMS structural-parametric synthesis for inspection and monitoring components of SMR are presented and discussed. The possibility of automated knowledge growth in ontologies is discussed.

articleTitle: A Secure Cloud Computing Method for Rapid Implementation of Cryptographic Data Protection in IoT
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Dependable Systems, Services and Technologies (DESSERT)
abstract: A method for secure implementation in the cloud of the basic public key cryptography operation modular exponentiation - is proposed. The method is intended for the rapid implementation of information security functions in remote control systems based on IoT technology. It is theoretically and experimentally proven that by using the results of intermediate calculations from the cloud on an IoT microcontroller terminal, the proposed method allows to increase the security level by several orders of magnitude compared to known methods with the same performance characteristics.

articleTitle: Search for the Shortest Route Considering Physical Obstacles: Method of Controlled Waterfall, Tool, and Application
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Dependable Systems, Services and Technologies (DESSERT)
abstract: The article overviews solutions for organizing LiFi communication in an obstacle-ridden environment using UAVs. The goal of the research is to develop an improved rectangle method approach and a tool to provide reliable P2P communication for a swarm of UAVs in an obstacle environment. Approaches for developing algorithms for circumventing mechanical obstacles considering communication range constraints are described. Methods and algorithms for solving the problem are developed. A tool for constructing a P2P route in obstacle conditions and comparing the rectangle method with the presented improvements for the minimum distance traveled and the minimum number of UAVs deployed are presented.

articleTitle: Assessing Ukrainian Territory Suitability for Solar Power Station Placement Using Satellite Data on Climate and Topography
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Dependable Systems, Services and Technologies (DESSERT)
abstract: This research aims to assess the suitability of Ukrainian territories for the placement of solar power stations using satellite data on climate and topographic characteristics. The suitability of the territories was determined using a weighted sum method, incorporating input parameters from climate maps sourced from ERA5-Land dataset, which included data on annual global horizontal solar irradiation (GHI), accumulated annual temperature above $25^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$, average annual wind speed, and maps of accumulated annual precipitation. Additionally, topographic maps from the SRTM dataset were utilized, providing information on elevations, slopes, and terrain shading. Furthermore, data from Wikimapia on the locations of existing major solar power stations in Ukraine were used to verify the placement optimization. The results of the study revealed that the largest portion of the country (over 48%) exhibits moderate suitability scores (0.3-0.4). Favorable territories (suitability score above 0.3) outweigh unsuitable ones for solar power stations. The southern regions and the Crimean Peninsula offer the most favorable conditions for the placement of solar farms. Overall, all analyzed major solar power stations in Ukraine were located in optimal territories. Furthermore, it was found that certain regions such as Odessa, Poltava, Kharkiv, Zaporizhia, Dnipropetrovsk, Donetsk, and Luhansk demonstrate good suitability scores (0.3-0.4), yet they are not fully exploited. These regions hold significant potential for the future construction of powerful and productive solar power stations.

articleTitle: Geospatial Analysis of Life Quality in Ukrainian Rural Areas
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Dependable Systems, Services and Technologies (DESSERT)
abstract: In this work, the authors developed an initial algorithm for assessing the quality of life in rural areas of Ukraine using the aggregation of heterogeneous geospatial information. The approach consists in a comprehensive assessment of the remoteness of the village from vital infrastructure facilities (hospitals, educational institutions, banks, libraries, shops, roads, power lines, etc.), to natural ecosystems (water bodies, forests or parks), as well as to occupied territories. The obtained results show that the largest number of villages with a depressed quality of life are located in the eastern and southern territories of the country, and with a positive quality - mainly in the west and central Ukraine. This, of course, is partly related to active hostilities, but considering that the proposed algorithm works based on the analysis of distances to various objects, it can be concluded that the war only worsened the condition of life in the villages.

articleTitle: Automatic System for Clamping Objects on Rotary Executive Links of Robotics for Safety Critical Application: Solution and Software for Modelling
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Dependable Systems, Services and Technologies (DESSERT)
abstract: A new method is proposed to improve the mechanisms for object fixation in robots handling critical application objects to ensure safety. The approach recommends utilizing software products developed specifically for this purpose. The applications improve the device’s prototyping capabilities, visualize its structural schemes, and calculate its individual performance characteristics. The structural diagram of the proposed device complies with the formulated security recommendations.

articleTitle: Fast Exponential Method on Galois Fields for Cryptographic Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Dependable Systems, Services and Technologies (DESSERT)
abstract: A method for accelerated calculation of the exponent on Galois fields is proposed and investigated in relation to its use in cryptography. Acceleration is achieved through the use of precomputations that depend on the generating polynomial and the number over which the exponentiation is performed. Special procedures have been developed for fast squaring and multiplication by a constant number on Galois fields, based on the use of precalculations. It has been theoretically and experimentally proven that the developed method allows an 8-fold increase in the speed of calculating the exponent on Galois fields compared to known methods.

Author Keywords: cryptographic algorithms based on Galois Fields algebra

articleTitle: Modeling of Local Power Systems Development under Conditions of Military Operations
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Dependable Systems, Services and Technologies (DESSERT)
abstract: The development planning model of generating capacities of the electric power system under conditions of significant penetration of renewable generation technologies are presented. The model reflects a typical scenario of military threats and its impact on the forecast load modes of generating equipment of the electric power system, consumer consumption restriction modes, as well as planes for the generating capacities development. The structure of the mathematical model is described. The results of a computational experiment on planning the development of generating capacities of the Local Electric Power System, which operates in parallel with the national electric power system in the summer, and in an isolated mode in the winter under the influence of military threats, is presented. The necessity of taking military threats into account when planning the development of the power system is shown.

articleTitle: The MFS for Electromagnetic Scattering by a Chiral Object in Two Dimensions
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Dependable Systems, Services and Technologies (DESSERT)
abstract: The scattering problem of time-harmonic electromagnetic waves by an infinite penetrable chiral cylinder embedded in an achiral environment is considered. The cylinder is considered to be parallel to x3-axis and the fields are assumed to be independent of the x3 variable. Using the Bohren’s decomposition, the scattering problem is reduced to a system of two-dimensional Helmholtz equations. The method of fundamental solutions (MFS) for two-dimensional scattering problems in chiral media is applied in order to approximate the solution. Specifically, the fields are expressed by finite linear combinations of the fundamental solutions with singularities placed on appropriate auxiliary curves. The unknown coefficients are determined from the transmission conditions. Numerical results are presented for the geometric cases of circle and ellipse using constructed MATLAB code.

articleTitle: Dependable and Resilient Emergency MAGDM Approach for the Selection of HADCs
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Dependable Systems, Services and Technologies (DESSERT)
abstract: Today, much attention is paid to the engineering of dependable and resilient intelligent systems and models. This direction includes multi-attribute group decision making (MAGDM) models and systems in emergency situations. As a rule, they are characterized by insufficient objective data and lack of response time to the solution of the problem. We consider in this direction a new MAGDM of facilities locations selection problem (FLSP) based on the Technique for Order Preference by Similarity to Ideal Solution (TOPSIS) approach. Expert’s evaluations of each candidate of humanitarian aid distribution center (HADC) relative to uncertain attributes in q-rung orthopair fuzzy numbers (q-ROFNs) are presented. The offered model is examined with a numerical example.

articleTitle: Data Mining of Ambulatory Blood Pressure Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Dependable Systems, Services and Technologies (DESSERT)
abstract: The paper’s aim is data mining of the recently published (2017) Ambulatory Blood Pressure Monitoring database, which covers 270 patients. Preprocessing, denoising, unsupervised Machine Learning (clustering), and feature selection were performed within Java-based software (WEKA 3-9-6). The Blood Pressure Load Level showed the best congruence with the obtained clusters. It also has the lowest noise among other levels of the database. The methods are designed to simplify database mining for clinicians largely unfamiliar with machine learning algorithms and benefit from simple algorithm approaches and visual aids output.

articleTitle: Evidence Theory and Fuzzy Discriminations in Dependable and Resilient Interactive MADM. Application in Emergency Psychiatric Diagnostics
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Dependable Systems, Services and Technologies (DESSERT)
abstract: Today, much attention is paid to the engineering of dependable and resilient intelligent systems and models. This direction includes multi-attribute decision-making (MADM) models and systems in emergency situations. A new interactive MADM approach based on evidence theory and fuzzy discrimination analysis is developed. MADM’s utilities in the discrimination q-rung orthopair fuzzy values in the Dempster-Shaper’s believe structure environment are transformed. New aggregation operators - extensions of Dempster’s extremal expectations under discrimination q-rung orthopair fuzzy information are constructed. MADM’s alternatives by new constructed operators are ranked. For the illustration of obtained results, a numerical example is created from Emergency Psychiatric Diagnostics (EPD).

articleTitle: Using an expression tree for adaptive learning
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Dependable Systems, Services and Technologies (DESSERT)
abstract: This article presents a model of comparing two arithmetic expressions for use in adaptive learning. The comparison model is based on a new expression non-binary tree model. The new expression tree model avoids the stable order of operands in mathematical operations and makes possible to compare two expressions that are identical in meaning but may look different. The algorithm for building the non-binary expression tree is created depends on two main methods that decide to add a new node in the tree as a parent node or as a child node. The expression tree comparison model contains expression tree normalisation, node precomputation and comparison expression trees steps. The comparison step contains an algorithm for finding similar nodes using similarity index. This index searches for similar child nodes in two expression trees to compare the original expression with the modified expression. These similar nodes are compared to obtain suggestions on how to bring the modified expression to the original expression.

articleTitle: Databases for Digital Infrastructure of Small Modular Reactors Considering Dynamic Subject Area
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Dependable Systems, Services and Technologies (DESSERT)
abstract: The paper analyses the digital infrastructure (DIS) of small modular reactors (SMRs), their main systems (Instrumentation and Control Systems of SMR, Supervision Information and Control System, System of Exchanging and Processing Information of Crisis Center, System of Physical Security and Protection, System of Radiation Control, UAV Fleet Control System, System of Consumption Management), and requirements to databases as a part of the DIS. It describes methods of forming dynamic subject areas (DSA) considering the specific features of SMR DIS. The results of DSA analysis and suggestions for developing an integrative database for SMR are presented.

articleTitle: State-based Sandbox Tool for Distributed Malware Detection with Avoid Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Dependable Systems, Services and Technologies (DESSERT)
abstract: This paper deals with the problem of detecting the malware by using emulation approach. Modern malware include various avoid techniques, to hide its anomaly actions. Advantages of using sandbox and emulation technologies are described. Various anti-emulation techniques that are used in modern malware considered. Obfuscation as one primary approach to hide malware malicious actions described and discussed. State of emulator is presented, and the advantages of its usage are covered. Distributed model for malware detection is considered. Basic emulator and its current capabilities presented. Prepared files that represent malware are described. Experimental results for developed files that differs with included avoid techniques are presented. Disadvantages of proposed approach is described. Future research and sandbox improvement are described.

articleTitle: Design of a Defense Controlled Vocabulary, SKOS-based Encoding of Terms from Military Press Releases
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Dependable Systems, Services and Technologies (DESSERT)
abstract: Controlled vocabularies are terminologies to describe domain knowledge and assist with various tasks related to computer systems communication. For instance, controlled vocabularies reduce data ambiguity by referencing term definitions, support the development of taxonomies, facilitate integration of concepts across ontologies, and support the semantic interoperability between disparate computer systems for the exchange of data. Cyberwarfare-related informatics research is driven by the gathering and use of information relevant to defense and warfare. Before computing complex tasks, computer tools and applications require formal representations of the information and knowledge they process. The purpose of this study is to propose the design of a novel controlled vocabulary for the description of armed conflict-related events with the focus on the Russo-Ukrainian conflict. Data about this research is collected from the NATO Newsroom. The simple knowledge organization system (SKOS) recommendation is utilized to encode the data. The initial version of a methodology for the formal representation of defense knowledge using semantic web technologies is presented in this paper.

articleTitle: Social Engineering Attacks Detection Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Dependable Systems, Services and Technologies (DESSERT)
abstract: The paper focuses on the problem of technical social engineering attacks that encompass the manipulation of individuals to reveal sensitive information, execute actions, or breach security systems. These exploits frequently capitalize on human psychology, trust, and a lack of vigilance to attain unauthorized entry to networks, systems, or data. In contrast to traditional social engineering tactics that center on psychological manipulation, technical social engineering attacks employ technological means and strategies to manipulate and beguile individuals. The paper presents an attempt to detect social engineering attacks. The approach utilized four machine learning algorithms (decision tree, random forest, K-nearest neighbor, and extreme gradient boosting). The analysis is centered on data collected from network hosts, which may serve as indicators of a potential social engineering attack. The empirical results demonstrated high detection accuracy.

articleTitle: Towards Effective Safety and Cybersecurity Co-engineering in Critical Domains
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Dependable Systems, Services and Technologies (DESSERT)
abstract: The primary objective of functional safety and cybersecurity co-engineering is to streamline assessment processes and enhance efficiency by implementing integrated approaches, therefore reducing overall effort and bringing several consequential advantages. Although this concept is not new, and there have already been successful attempts at its utilization in different critical domains such as nuclear, railway, and automotive, no mature approach could be easily adopted and applied during the assessment. Another challenge is that the understanding of co-engineering is essentially different, depending on domain specifics and priorities. Moreover, issues are still related to measuring efficiency achieved by co-engineering utilization. This paper addresses the current state of safety and cybersecurity co-engineering in critical domains. With a focus on nuclear, automotive, and railway domains, it proposes directions toward developing effective co-engineering frameworks for them.

articleTitle: Maximum Double Coverage by Wireless Sensor Network with Fixed Number of Sensors
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Dependable Systems, Services and Technologies (DESSERT)
abstract: The paper is devoted to the issues of increasing the reliability of sensor networks by increasing the fold coverage. A bounded continuous sensing region and a fixed number of sensors with unequal circular sensing ranges are considered. The problem is to find such location of sensors at which the maximum double coverage of the region is achieved. The results obtained can be generalized to the case of an arbitrary multiple coverage. Since the number of sensors is assumed to be limited, and the sensing ranges are bounded, there is no guarantee of double coverage of the region. Therefore, we pose the maximum double coverage problem. We study some cases depending on whether complete single coverage of the region is required. The formulations and mathematical models of the corresponding classes of double coverage problems are considered. Original optimization approach for solving problems are proposed. The implementation of the approach has been tested for the polygonal shape of the region and the binary disk sensing model of sensors.

articleTitle: Availability Markov Models of Complex Equipment with Relearning Diagnostic Means after Detecting Latent Failures
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Dependable Systems, Services and Technologies (DESSERT)
abstract: Availability assessment is one of the core processes in reliable systems. Downtime can be reduced in many ways, from preventing errors through proper testing to reducing maintenance and repair time. However, this article considers a different approach - improving the reliability of error detection by providing the diagnostic system with a learning component that should increase the reliability of the system. While the learning phase may increase system downtime, it may be beneficial to have a more robust error detection system that begins to improve reliability at a certain point in time significantly. To investigate this hypothesis and analyze the dependencies, the diagnostic system was modeled as a multifragment Markov chain (MFMC) in R. The results of this work can be summarized as follows: 1) A general approach to the construction of a linear multifragment Markov chain in R was developed. 2) A general-purpose diagnostic system was built and represented as an MFMC. 3) Investigate how the learning state of the model, the intensity of error detection improvement, and other parameters affect the availability function, as well as what combinations and approaches are appropriate for specific business cases.

articleTitle: A Two Step Chaos-Based 3D Model Encryption
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Dependable Systems, Services and Technologies (DESSERT)
abstract: Augmented and virtual reality, game designing, medicine, medical engineering, and many other fields all revolve around 3D models. This is because 3D models have superior visual information than digital images. However, in recent years the advancements in digital image encryption are more rapid than in 3D model encryption. As such, more study on 3D model encryption is deemed necessary. In this paper, a new 3D model chaos-based encryption scheme is suggested based on a shuffling process on the vertices and faces that compose the 3D object and a modulation on the vertex coordinates. The effectiveness of the proposed encryption technique is then verified through the distribution of occupied position analysis, peak signal to noise ratio, structural similarity index and correlation coefficients.

articleTitle: Overview of the modern SoC design technologies and open softprocessor architectures
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Dependable Systems, Services and Technologies (DESSERT)
abstract: The analysis of existing platforms and tools for designing systems on chip is given. The variants of soft-processor architectures that are relevant at the current moment are considered, prospective directions of research and integration into embedded systems are determined. The overview of solutions based on the RISC-V architecture and softcore processors based on them was conducted. The existing solutions from FPGA vendors to realize the possibilities of partial reconfiguration of the system are considered. The typical problems encountered in the design of embedded systems and possible tools which can be used for requirements analysis are presented.

articleTitle: A Framework for Detection of MitM Cyberattacks in Smart Grid Networks Based on the Application of the Ensemble Process for Feature Selection
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Dependable Systems, Services and Technologies (DESSERT)
abstract: Recent years have shown an increase in the number and complexity of cyberattacks not only on traditional IT infrastructures, but also on smart energy supply networks. Cybercriminals and cyberspies are becoming more sophisticated and persistent in their actions, which requires increased cyber security measures and the development of new technologies to protect infrastructure. In this work we present a framework for detection of Man-in-the-Middle cyberattacks in smart grids based on the application of the ensemble process for feature selection. The workflow of the framework consists of two main stages: model creation and performance evaluation. To create the model, a study was carried out, which involved the selection of the optimal set of features by applying various methods of feature selection. In addition to the sets of features that were formed by feature selection methods, another set of features was formed, which is the result of the process of assembling features that were formed by feature selection methods. A feature score was proposed, which allows weighting of each feature depending on its frequency of selection in all selection methods and the relative number of selected features in the entire set. To check the effectiveness of detecting MitM cyberattacks, SVM and Decision Tree classifiers were used, the test data for which were generated according to the obtained sets of features.

articleTitle: The MFS for Electromagnetic Scattering by a Layered Chiral Object
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Dependable Systems, Services and Technologies (DESSERT)
abstract: The scattering of time-harmonic electromagnetic waves by a layered chiral obstacle is considered. The direct scattering problem is formulated. Surface vector potentials in terms of the dyadic fundamental solutions of the differential operators governing the problem are defined. The Method of Fundamental Solutions (MFS) is applied in order to approximate the sought for solution by finite linear combinations in terms of the dyadic fundamental solutions for singularities placed on auxiliary surfaces outside the domain of the solution and for unknown vector coefficients determined by the conditions on the scatterer’s surfaces. A system of vector functions containing the tangential components of the columns of the dyadic fundamental solutions is constructed. Completeness and linear independence of the constructed system is proven on the surfaces of the scatterer using the defined surface vector potentials. It is concluded that the approximation of the solution by the finite linear combinations is reduced to the approximation of the boundary data. The corresponding MFS approximations of the far-field data are constructed. Imposing the transmission conditions to a finite number of collocation points on the surfaces of the scatterer transforms the problem to an algebraic linear system whose solution determines the unknown vector coefficients. Numerical results obtained by the implementation of the method are presented for the case of a two-layered chiral sphere embedded in a chiral medium.

articleTitle: OpenStreetMap Integration into the System of People Safety and Protection in Emergencies
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Dependable Systems, Services and Technologies (DESSERT)
abstract: Over the last few decades, many countries have been challenged by the devastating consequences of natural disasters and wars which pose a significant threat to human health and safety. Timely information related to the distribution of vulnerable population and critical infrastructure is key for effective disaster relief. OpenStreetMap (OSM) has repeatedly been shown to be highly suitable for disaster mapping and management. The paper is devoted to OSM integration into the system of people safety and protection in emergencies. The main features of utilizing principles of people safety are described and discussed in particular emergency situation. Examples of OSM working are given and analyzed. SWOT-analysis that assesses the possibility of integrating OSM into existing emergency protection systems has been described. The work on the formation of the algorithm, according to which the calculations will be carried out was made. The application, that includes some useful buttons for people safety was explored.

articleTitle: Intelligent extraction of the informative features for UAV motion modelling: principles and techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Dependable Systems, Services and Technologies (DESSERT)
abstract: The aim of the article is to develop a methodology for intelligent extraction of informative features of unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) motion modelling using a Variational Autoencoder. Practical use of the developed methodology will allow to extract the most informative features of UAV motion modelling in the process of intelligent flight path planning. This fact will further reduce the complexity of calculations on their analysis and processing using the selected bases.In order to achieve this goal, a practical set of input data of the Variational Autoencoder is generated and investigations are carried out for examples of UAV velocity variation and manoeuvring. The autoencoder is used to reduce the dimensionality of the data to 3 indices, which will further reduce the complexity of the calculations to analyse and process them using the chosen bases. In the context of UAV motion modelling, this allowed up to 30% reduction in the volume of calculations.

articleTitle: About One Possible Tool for Analysing Safeness of Discrete Dynamic Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Dependable Systems, Services and Technologies (DESSERT)
abstract: The paper is devoted to developing the coalgebraic technique for specifying and analyzing general discrete systems that can be used for modeling distributed, embedded, and cyber-physical ones. The authors ground this technique with an assumption of two specification languages. In more detail, each language specifies the actual state associated with the corresponding language for describing forecasts about system states. An endofunctor in the appropriate category models the relationships between these languages. This assumption leads us to consider the system’s dynamical transformation as a forecasting mechanism and model it with the corresponding coalgebraic operation.The introduction of the concept of an eventual coalgebra is an attempt to provide a coalgebraic formalization of steady system behavior, avoiding reference to the notion of a final coalgebra. This is motivated by the importance of final coalgebras in studying limiting properties of systems and the absence of final coalgebras for practically interesting types of systems. The authors assume that the approach outlined in the article allows for the analysis of practical and significant systems, those for which determining the final coalgebra is not feasible.In the paper as well, the properties of eventual coalgebras are studied, and their functorial nature is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Blood Smear Leukocyte Identification Using an Image Segmentation Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Dependable Systems, Services and Technologies (DESSERT)
abstract: The focus of this study is on biomedical image data processing and analysis. The primary objective is to identify leukocytes in blood smear samples and determine their quantities. Since the manual laboratory processing of this data is a laborious task, it is susceptible to subjectivity and time-consuming. Hence, the objective of this study is to examine contemporary processing methodologies and existing technologies that have the potential to speed up and automate this procedure. This study presents a concept that utilizes existing methods to address a problem, including a unique sequence of operations. Finally, it evaluates the accuracy of this approach for future research. This approach has the potential to be used in the diagnosis of a range of disorders, including blood malignancies or infections.

articleTitle: Development and Interaction of the VTF Concept with IoT Platforms on the Example of the 5G Standard
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Dependable Systems, Services and Technologies (DESSERT)
abstract: The main prospects of development and interaction of mobile telecommunication networks are given, taking into account the potential opportunities for the realization of scenarios for the implementation of virtual technical functions on the platforms of the Internet of Things with the appropriate quality of service. The advantages and disadvantages of individual scenarios for the implementation of the concept of virtual technical functions are considered. An attempt is made to describe the principles of interaction of the 5G mobile network standard with Internet of Things platforms. Some aspects of the development of mobile communication systems are recognized, taking the promising technologies and recommendations of the ITU into consideration. The basic principles of construction of mobile communication networks are given, including the potential implementation possibilities of any realization scenario of virtual technical functions with set requirements for a given quality of service. The advantages and disadvantages of individual scenarios for the implementation of the concept of virtual technical functions are contemplated.

articleTitle: Threats Detection and Analysis Based on SYSMON Tool
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Dependable Systems, Services and Technologies (DESSERT)
abstract: In this work, an nalysis for the study of threats in a real environment with the possibility of conducting a full-fledged analysis of threats, as well as their simulationhas been developed for research purposes. Designed laboratory was built for the threats research, specification of deploying and configuring Sysmon, imitation of an attack in laboratory conditions and its investigation by implicit signs, the processesing of threat analysis using the Sysmon tool. We present a system based on the analysis of continuous input chan-nels of Sysmon logs. The system is based on the Cyber Threat Analysis Ontology and analyzes SYSMON logs to classify software according to different threat levels and enhance cyber defense capabilities with situational awareness, prediction and auto-mated actions. The developed laboratory improves the effectiveness of threat analysis using the Sysmon tool, makes study of threats, deploying and configuring Sysmon, imitation of an attack in laboratory conditions and its investigation by implicit signs. It can be applied for the study of threats in a real environment with the possibility of conducting a full-fledged analysis of threats, as well as their simulation for research purposes.

articleTitle: Road Accident Prevention System
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Dependable Systems, Services and Technologies (DESSERT)
abstract: In the modern world, road safety remains a relevant issue as the number of vehicles on the road continues to grow. The alarming statistics of accidents, injuries and fatalities demonstrate the urgent need for effective measures to prevent dangerous situations on the road. This article discusses an advanced system developed to address this issue by combining various subsystems. These include speed detection, safe distance calculation, determination of the speed of the vehicle in front of you, road sign recognition, driver notification, and violation data collection. By integrating these subsystems, the system aims to improve road safety and reduce the risks associated with accidents.

articleTitle: Asymptotic assessment of the functional safety of information interaction in the SDH architecture at the network and transport OSI layers
publicationTitle: 2023 13th International Conference on Dependable Systems, Services and Technologies (DESSERT)
abstract: Assessment of the functional safety of network architectures is, in general, a task of exponentially increasing computational complexity, because the number of computational operations grows in geometric progression with the increase in the number of internodal connections. Considering the high practical value of such an assessment, researchers resort to limitations, which, for the most part, are imposed on the network architecture and the nomenclature of the dependability metric.
